Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About the position

Do you have a good eye for design, interiors and photography, and an interest in how a design house collaborates with creative voices? As GUBI’s Creative Partnerships & Social Intern, you’ll help build two new programmes from the start. One is a creative partnerships programme with photographers, stylists, writers and storytellers whose perspective brings something new to the conversation around design. The other is an affiliate programme with creators across Europe. You’ll work closely with the programme lead and collaborate with colleagues across Marketing and E-commerce, helping keep collaborations running smoothly from first contact to published content.

Key responsibilities

• Support outreach to new creators and partners and help onboard them into the affiliate programme, including preparing agreements and briefs.

• Coordinate gifting and product seeding, from approval through stock checks, shipping and follow-up.

• Support the content calendar and our social channels, and bring your own ideas to the table.

• Help create briefs for creative collaborations and attend shoots when they take place in Copenhagen.

• Maintain an overview of product shipments, content received and partnership deliverables.

• Support the preparation of monthly reports on reach, engagement and affiliate sales.

• Support other social and partnership projects as needed.

Qualifications

• A good eye for design, interiors and photography, with solid design knowledge and references.

• You follow creators and design media, and can identify content and potential partners relevant to GUBI.

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic performance data.

• Experience with Notion, Figma and social platforms is an advantage.

• Video editing or graphic design skills are a bonus, but not required.

Language skills

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Personal attributes

• Organised and very detail-oriented, with a structured approach to tasks.

• Proactive in following up to keep collaborations moving, and willing to ask questions along the way.

• Comfortable managing several tasks at once and adapting when priorities change.

• Curious, open-minded and collaborative.

Application

If you are excited about this opportunity and see yourself as a great fit for the GUBI team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application, CV, and other relevant information using the link below:

For our customer Deloitte, we are looking for a Software Engineer/Architects. With more than 3000 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. They tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services and Consulting.

About the team

The Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation are on the lookout for additional team-players for their practice of 80+ software engineers, (cloud) architects, cloud strategists, and IT management consultants. The team assists some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new IT systems as part of their digital transformation – and you can help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together you will be able to accelerate your career as a developer. At Deloitte, they are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Consulting is second to none. They offer everything from various sports communities to internal hackathons – not to forget the yearly Consulting Trip where all our colleagues get together off-site to create life lasting memories.

Job Description

As a Developer, you will be part of the technical teams through the entire development process—from requirements specification and architecture to implementation and testing. You will work closely with both clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet their business needs and technical requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

• Assisting in the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and adopting DevOps practices to streamline development workflows.

• Assisting in designing and communicating architectural overviews such as target architecture and solution architecture

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

What you bring to the team:

• A master’s degree within IT, Engineering or similar

• 2-10 years experience as a software engineer/architect.

• Strong technical knowledge in Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, or one or more other widely used programming languages.

• Preferably experience with at least one of the major cloud providers (Azure, AWS or GCP)

• High proficiency in written and spoken English and are either a native Danish speaker or possess a high proficiency in written and spoken Danish.

• It will be a big advantage if you have previous consulting experience

• Experience with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and test automation.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

We aim to fill the position as soon as possible and will evaluate applications as they arrive.

You can learn more about Deloitte here:

https://www2.deloitte.com/global/en.html

Your role

This is not a pure channel management role. You will own how we acquire users and merchants, from the first ad impression to the first cashback earned.

We are looking for a hands-on marketing specialist who combines deep paid media skills with a structured, test-driven mindset. You care about clicks and installs, but more about activated users who stay, shop and earn. You set up the experiments, read the data and make the call.

You report to our Chief Growth Officer and play a central role in scaling Loyalty Key across the Nordics. You get real budget, real ownership and short decision paths.

Working at Loyalty Key

Loyalty Key is building the Nordic standard for payment-linked loyalty. Our technology turns everyday card payments into automatic rewards: no coupons, no points, no receipts. Just cashback, straight to the consumer, every time they shop with a partner.

We power loyalty for some of the region's strongest brands, including Visa, Danske Bank and SAS EuroBonus, and connect consumers with more than 2,000 merchants. Our own consumer app, Cashback med Visa, puts that network directly in people's pockets.

We are a Copenhagen-based team with an ambitious plan: to make card-linked cashback something every Nordic cardholder uses, and every merchant wants to be part of.

What you will own

Your main focus is consumer growth: getting the right people to download the app, sign up and start earning. You will also drive lead generation towards merchants who want to join our network.

Performance roadmap

• 
Own the paid acquisition roadmap across channels and markets

• 
Identify what limits growth today, and prioritize the work that moves the needle

• 
Balance volume, user quality and cost, and make those trade-offs visible

Paid acquisition

• 
Run and scale campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and Snapchat

• 
Drive app user acquisition through programmatic and mobile DSP partners

• 
Manage budgets, pacing and channel allocation

Creative and messaging

• 
Build a structured creative testing framework: hypothesis, variant, iteration

• 
Brief designers, UGC creators and agency partners with clear, data-backed direction

• 
Find the hooks, offers and merchant stories that turn attention into signups

Landing pages and conversion

• 
Own conversion beyond the ad click: landing pages, app store listings and signup flows

• 
Run A/B tests on pages, offers and onboarding steps

• 
Optimize for activated users, not just installs

Agency and partner management

• 
Lead our external performance agency with clear goals and accountability for results

• 
Work with DSP and media partners on setup, performance and reporting

• 
Contribute to joint campaigns with brand partners such as Visa

B2B lead generation

• 
Run lead campaigns towards merchants and hand qualified leads to our sales team

• 
Follow the full path from lead to meeting to signed merchant, and optimize for quality

What you'll bring

We are looking for an experienced performance marketing specialist: deep in paid acquisition, broad enough to improve the whole funnel around it.

Essential

• 
3–5 years of experience in performance or growth marketing, in-house or agency side

• 
Deep hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads

• 
Proven experience with at least one of TikTok, Snapchat or programmatic / mobile DSP

• 
A track record of structured creative testing, with results you can point to

• 
Hands-on experience with landing page optimization and A/B testing

• 
Strong analytical skills: you build your own reports and let data drive decisions

• 
Experience leading agencies or media partners towards commercial goals

• 
High ownership and a bias for action: you get things live and iterate

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken

Strongly preferred

• 
App marketing experience, including mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer

• 
A background in fintech, loyalty, e-commerce or consumer apps

• 
B2B lead generation experience, ideally with HubSpot or a similar CRM

• 
Experience running campaigns across several markets

Perks and benefits

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Pension scheme

• 
Health insurance

• 
Lunch scheme

• 
Social events

• 
Personal learning budget

Our recruitment process

• 
Interview with our Chief Growth Officer (60 min): your experience, your way of working and the results you have driven

• 
Case presentation (45 min): you present a short growth plan based on a case we share with you in advance

Equal opportunity

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We hire on skills, experience and potential, and we believe diverse teams build better products.

Start date and location:

Start date by agreement.

Address: Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

For further information, please contact Allan Stolc, aas@loyaltykey.com

Do you like testing complex systems and working closely with developers? We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our Product Extension Team in Copenhagen. You will bring senior test expertise to a small team that builds integrations and extensions for Systematic's defence products, with real influence on how we test and improve.

The job

As the team's senior tester, you will be its quality advocate, driving how we test and improve across the full development lifecycle. You will combine hands-on test execution with real influence over our testing tools, methods and processes.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning, estimating and executing test activities, and contributing to test estimates in project planning

• Driving quality across the development lifecycle through risk-based test design

• Developing and maintaining system-level automated tests that support feature testing

• Challenging developers and projects on where automation makes the most sense, including weak points in developer-driven tests

• Improving our test tools, methods and processes

You should expect occasional travel of around five to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team in Defence Services, around seven developers, test engineers and architects. The team delivers software and hardware integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability solutions with external systems, so our customers get functionality tailored to their needs without compromising on quality or maintainability. As the team's senior tester, you will work closely with developers, architects, project management, external system providers and customer representatives, and share your knowledge by mentoring our junior test engineer and running workshops.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience in software and/or systems testing, along with:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

• Experience with test management and test design methods

• The ability to drive the implementation of test frameworks and tools, and to review and adapt existing automated test setups

• Familiarity with integrations, APIs, protocols and hardware validation setups

• Experience with tools like JUnit, Cucumber, Playwright, Jira, Xray, Karma and TeamCity, or similar

• Fluent English; Danish is a nice-to-have

ISTQB Foundation certification, or similar, is an advantage but not a requirement.

Alongside this, we value:

• A proactive and independent approach, with strong analytical skills and a risk-based mindset

• An ability to build relationships and work across teams and projects

• Curiosity about customer needs and how the system is actually used

• A willingness to share information openly and help others learn

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Andreas Markussen, Senior Manager.

Ambu A/S is looking for a Senior Portfolio Management Consultant to join the Innovation PMO.

You will work with complex, cross-functional topics related to portfolio management, governance and business performance. Your role is to define the problem, build the fact base, align stakeholders, recommend solutions and establish ownership for implementation.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will work closely with colleagues across the PMO and senior stakeholders across Ambu.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

Key responsibilities

• 
Cross-functional initiatives

• 
Drive selected cross-functional topics from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and stakeholder alignment.

• 
Define decisions, actions and ownership, and hand over execution to the relevant business owner.

• 
Portfolio governance and ways of working

• 
Evaluate and improve processes for project portfolio prioritization, resource management, project governance and performance follow-up.

• 
Translate business goals and requirements and input from subject-matter experts into clear processes, roles, decision criteria and governance.

• 
Analysis and decision support

• 
Analyse portfolio, project, resource and business-performance information to identify issues and recommend actions.

• 
Develop scenarios, recommendations and decision material for senior management.

• 
Management support

• 
Take ownership of selected analyses and cross-functional topics on behalf of the Director, Innovation PMO.

• 
Prepare recommendations, presentation material and follow up agreed actions with relevant stakeholders.

Suggested candidate profile

**Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have relevant experience within project portfolio management, management consulting, PMO, business transformation or operational excellence.

• Have taken complex, cross-functional business problems from initial question to analysis, recommendation and agreed action.

• Have aligned senior stakeholders across functions, including situations with different priorities and no direct reporting relationship.

• Have hands-on experience with portfolio management, prioritization, governance, resource management and/or performance reporting.

• Have prepared analyses, decision recommendations and presentation material for senior management.

• Can work independently with loosely defined assignments, while knowing when to involve subject-matter experts and decision-makers.

• Communicate clearly and concisely in English, both in writing and presentations.

Experience from MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role: Marketing Student Assistant

As our Marketing Student Assistant, you'll play a crucial supporting role within the Elanco Pet Health Nordics team, working closely with the Nordic Marketing Manager. This unique opportunity allows you to gain hands-on experience across diverse marketing activities and touchpoints for a broad portfolio of medicinal products in multiple Nordic markets.

Your Responsibilities:

• Support the Marketing Manager in daily marketing tasks and assist with Advertising & Promotion (A&P) cost tracking.

• Manage orders for promotional items, merchandise, and giveaways.

• Maintain and update material inventories and activity plans.

• Contribute to media planning and the development of media assets.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):

• Prior digital marketing experience.

• A team player with a strong customer focus and a proactive mindset.

Additional Information:

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Application deadline: Ongoing interviews, apply as soon as possible. Please attach your cover letter as well.

**Vice President, Head of Thickening

****Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Reports To

**Product Group Head – Separation

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Deliver aggressive growth targets through expansion of equipment sales, modernization programs, and installed-base opportunities.

• Manage business performance through rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews, financial analysis, and strategic planning.

• Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, Product Engineers, Applications / Proposals, Technical sales, etc.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer value, growth, and execution.

• Identify and develop new revenue streams, market opportunities, and business models that enhance lifecycle value creation.

**Commercial Leadership

**

• Define and implement global commercial strategies for Capital and U&R offerings.

• Lead the global sales growth agenda by partnering with Capital Sales teams, Regional Sales organizations, and key account leaders.

• Drive pipeline generation, conversion improvement, and sales excellence across all regions.

• Establish and govern global pricing strategies that optimize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

• Support major commercial negotiations and customer engagements for strategic opportunities.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

**

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within mining, minerals processing, capital equipment, or industrial technology businesses.

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

• Lifecycle Solutions Management

• Results orientation

Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a highly motivated, dynamic and social team focusing on financial lifecycle cost analysis of future and existing offshore wind projects. You’ll obtain key insights into our development pipeline and existing fleet where you will ensure best-in-class financial and investment support for our global offshore organization.

We are looking for an OPEX Financial Analyst with exceptional analytical skills to transform complex datasets into actionable insights. Proficiency in Excel and the ability to present findings clearly to various stakeholders are essential.

**Welcome to Technical Budgeting and Analysis

**You’ll be part of a team where you, together with your colleagues, will develop and benchmark operational lifetime budgets for our existing and future wind farms.

As a team, we will provide all analysis of OPEX cost and support management in taking decisions based on financial and business insights.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• taking ownership of your own portfolio of offshore wind projects and the responsibility to support our Offshore business with lifecycle cost assessments and financial analysis

• providing lifecycle cost assessment and financial analysis to our development projects during Bid, FID and maturation phase (incl. risk-, FX- and local content analysis)

• providing relevant high-quality financial analysis on OPEX activities for commercial decision support as well as presenting and reporting to senior management

• working with our M&A Valuation & Structuring team to support our divestment processes through quantitative evaluation of various O&M activities and concepts.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have keen interest in business and cost analysis and are curious to understand fundamental financial drivers behind the business case of an offshore wind farm

• have relevant work experience in the field of lifetime cost modelling, budget forecasting, financial analysis or similar

• thrive in an international, dynamic and fast paced, project environment where you keep the financial overview to ensure the integrity of our business cases and financial commitments

• have a positive can-do attitude and excellent communication skills to ensure complex financial matters are understood by all stakeholders and management

• are highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, enjoy working with large financial models and have a proactive mindset towards change.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

Lead generation is yours as a minimum. You own where the meetings come from: the customer profile, the lead lists and the sourcing of the right webshops, outbound and the campaigns that have to fill the pipeline. You measure what a meeting costs to acquire and which channels carry, and you shut down the ones that do not. You build it yourself at first and set direction for marketing and meeting booking as they come on board.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• Has built sales in a B2B SaaS company as one of the first salespeople, with own meetings and own closes

• Has built lead generation from scratch, through outbound, partners or marketing, and knows what pipeline costs to acquire

• Has had a budget and hit it, and can explain in detail how

• Sells personally and teaches others to do it at the same time

• Experience selling outside Denmark, and a feel for what changes when you do

• Strong product and technology understanding, and uses AI every day in their own work

• Danish at native level, confident on calls, in meetings and in demos

• Fluent English is mandatory. English is the office language at Userlink

The person

• Dreams of owning and building a company

• Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

• Competitive salary plus uncapped commission

• Equity
